items.summary: GREP.AI (YC F26) open-sourced its own agent harness as a full managed platform: bring your existing agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi via ACP) and after each run it keeps what helped as a note, skill or workflow, so the next run starts from there and uses fewer tokens. Runs survive restarts, agents get Docker sandboxes, and approvals plus spend caps live in one console. One npx command runs it locally, or self-host it in one click. Announced Nov 12, on Hacker News Nov 16.
items.title: AgentRun: Open-source self-improving agent platform that adds a learning and control layer to Claude Code, Codex and more (Show HN Nov 16, Apache 2.0)

items.summary: A Mac menu-bar app (also Windows, Linux, Docker) that runs a local model gateway on 127.0.0.1: every coding agent's model — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity CLI and dozens more — is switched in one place, so Claude Code can run on Kimi and Codex on DeepSeek. When one subscription's quota runs out it quietly moves to the next account or model, and secrets in prompts can be masked locally before they leave the machine. Open source (MIT), up 4,300+ stars this week to 38,000 total.
items.title: magpie: One local gateway for every coding agent's model — switch from the menu bar, auto failover when a quota runs out (4,300+ stars this week)
